snippet.title: Happy Harvest - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now!

Happy Harvest is a cozy idle farming game where you plant crops, earn coins, and gradually automate your farm until it runs itself. The sweet spot between relaxing and addictive. Your crops grow while you sleep, but you'll find yourself checking in anyway because watching them flourish feels good.
